items.v0_3_7_action_drawer_desc: Seamless mobile bottom drawer triggered by long-pressing messages and channels, featuring haptic feedback and auto-blurring keyboards.
items.v0_3_7_nested_submenu_desc: Support for multi-level nested sub-menu drill-down views within drawers with native top back buttons.
items.v0_3_7_mobile_actions_title: Redesigned Mobile Message Actions & Emoji Quick Bar
items.v0_3_7_mobile_actions_desc: Horizontal row of top quick emoji reactions with inline destructive confirmation for safer and faster message management.
items.v0_3_7_image_skeleton_desc: Dynamic scale factor calculation for images and loading skeletons on mobile screens to prevent layout breakage or overflow.
items.v0_3_7_mini_player_drag_title: Mini Audio Player Mobile Touch Dragging
items.v0_3_7_mini_player_drag_desc: Refactored dragging with W3C Pointer Events and pointer capture for smooth, gesture-conflict-free touch manipulation.
items.v0_3_7_long_press_debounce_desc: Optimized 450ms gold duration with a 10px movement tolerance threshold to cleanly differentiate scrolling from long-pressing.
items.v0_3_6_select_desc: Completely replaces native HTML select elements with accessible keyboard navigation and unified dark mode aesthetics.
items.v0_3_6_tooltip_desc: Replaces native title tooltips with zero-latency, adaptive-placement dark micro-bubbles rendered directly through body portals.
items.v0_3_6_attachment_menu_desc: Right-click images, audio clips, and file attachments for instant downloads, direct link copying, tab opening, and previewing.
items.v0_3_6_mini_player_title: Magnetic Snapping & Continuous Waveform Mini Player
items.v0_3_6_mini_player_desc: Freely draggable floating player with dual-sided edge snapping, smooth gradient clip-path waveform fill, and seek hover timestamps.
items.v0_3_6_voice_name_desc: Voice channels now preserve original letter casing and spaces, while text channels maintain normalized hyphenated slugs.
items.v0_3_6_voice_hud_title: Voice Topology Badges & Streamer HUD Relocation
items.v0_3_6_voice_hud_desc: Sidebar adds P2P and E2EE security indicators with simplified preview; streamer viewer badge relocated to top-left for cleaner layout.
items.v0_3_5_audio_player_desc: Replaces native HTML5 audio controls with custom Discord-styled cards featuring Web Audio PCM waveform peak extraction, drag-to-seek scrubbing, mute toggle, and 4-speed playback rates (1.0x-2.0x).
items.v0_3_5_mini_dock_title: Global Singleton Mutex Playback & Floating Mini Dock
items.v0_3_5_mini_dock_desc: Enforces single-instance mutex playback to eliminate overlapping audio; features a persistent bottom-right floating mini dock allowing seamless continuous playback and full controls across channels and guilds.
items.v0_3_5_media_e2ee_signaling_title: Realtime Media E2EE Signaling & Device Acknowledgment
items.v0_3_5_media_e2ee_signaling_desc: Enhances SFrame media key envelope distribution and acknowledgment pipelines over WebSocket with targeted per-device signaling and 2.5s polling fallback resiliency, verified by complete test suites.
items.v0_3_5_audio_lifecycle_title: Audio Lifecycle Safeguards & Waveform Drag Listener Cleanup
items.v0_3_5_audio_lifecycle_desc: Actively cleans up global waveform dragging listeners on component unmount, closes AudioContext in fallback finally blocks, and suppresses harmless AbortError and empty-src events during track switches.
items.v0_3_4_responsive_desc: Resolved an issue violating React Rules of Hooks during tablet orientation switches to prevent runtime crashes and ensure solid drawer gestures across all viewports.
items.v0_3_4_drag_desc: Prevented native image dragging on guild avatars and banners inside server invite cards, eliminating accidental file upload drops into chat.
items.v0_3_4_call_stage_desc: Removed technical connection details and unified the call setup phase into the sleek call stage design with end-to-end encryption indicators.
items.v0_3_4_snippet_desc: Smartly translated raw call history events (missed, canceled, declined, and duration) into localized message previews in direct message lists across all 5 supported locales.
items.v0_3_3_media_e2ee_desc: RFC 9605 compliant frame-level encryption for audio and video media streams. The server acts purely as a blind relay with zero access to plain payload.
items.v0_3_3_presence_desc: Introduces per-session status tracking and smart presence arbitration across multiple devices, automatic idle detection after 10m AFK, and debounced broadcast resolution.
items.v0_3_3_spoiler_title: Discord-Style Dynamic Mosaic Noise Spoiler Tag
items.v0_3_3_spoiler_desc: Supports ||spoiler content|| markdown syntax with animated particle noise canvas, click-to-reveal toggle interaction, and prefers-reduced-motion accessibility.
items.v0_3_3_invite_card_title: Rich Server Invite Embed & Auto Navigation
items.v0_3_3_invite_card_desc: Redesigns server invite links into Discord-grade rich embed cards with banners, icons, live presence/member counts, and one-click join with instant channel navigation.
items.v0_3_3_stl_preview_desc: Preview STL 3D models directly in chat attachments with full rotation, zoom, triangle count, physical dimensions (mm), and safe WebGL resource cleanup.
items.v0_3_3_loopback_desc: Native Windows C++ WASAPI capture addon for the desktop client, enabling secure per-process audio capture and lossless system audio streaming.
items.v0_3_3_animated_icon_desc: Support animated GIF guild icons with smooth hover playback, accompanied by server-side Sharp pixel-level security validation and decompression bomb defense.
items.v0_3_3_cursor_desc: Refactored message history with bidirectional cursor pagination to eliminate jumping, alongside responsive touch gesture drawers and context menus.
items.v0_3_2_search_desc: Supports full guild and channel message search, syntax pill filtering (from/in/has/pinned), keyword highlighting, and one-click Jump to message.
items.v0_3_2_invite_desc: Resolves friend invite clicks having no response, auto-pre-generates invite codes, on-demand fallback creation, and automatic DM invite cards.
items.v0_3_2_header_desc: Refactors responsive header layout with tiered truncation, auto-collapsing search button, and guaranteed visible pin and member buttons.
items.v0_3_2_touch_desc: Removes touch-none constraint to restore smooth scrolling, with a 1450ms continuous gesture state machine seamlessly handling long-press menus and drag reordering.
items.v0_3_1_emoji_desc: Support for personal and server custom emojis with a Discord-style emoji picker and inline reaction rendering.
items.v0_3_1_status_badge_desc: Pixel-perfect SVG cutout indicators for idle crescent, DND bar, and offline ring presence states.
items.v0_3_1_typography_desc: 13px-20px global font scaling with intrinsic chat image dimensions to eliminate layout shifts.
items.v0_3_1_admin_desc: Super-admin toggle to restrict regular user server creation, tailored for dedicated private deployments.
items.v0_3_1_upload_title: Mobile Safari Uploads & Deep Magic Bytes
items.v0_3_1_upload_desc: Fix for iOS Safari avatar uploads with robust binary magic byte inspection and decompression bomb guards.
items.v0_3_0_unread_desc: See unread indicators, mark channels or servers as read, and sync progress across devices.
items.v0_3_0_appearance_desc: Adjust chat font size, message density, and interface zoom.
items.v0_3_0_roles_desc: Updated member and role layouts and prevented overlapping role changes.
items.v0_3_0_brand_desc: A unified mascot now appears across the web and desktop apps, with an unread indicator in the desktop tray.
items.v0_2_0_livekit_desc: Seamlessly integrates LiveKit and Cloudflare Realtime for crystal-clear multi-user voice calls and HD screen sharing.
items.v0_2_0_rnnoise_title: RNNoise Neural Network Real-Time Noise Suppression
items.v0_2_0_rnnoise_desc: Runs deep neural networks in an isolated AudioWorklet thread to eliminate keyboard clicks and fan noises with zero perceptible latency.
items.v0_2_0_i18n_desc: Fully localized across Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese (TW/HK), English, and Japanese with zero hardcoded strings.
items.v0_2_0_updater_title: Dual-Track Delta Hot Updates with gh-proxy Acceleration
items.v0_2_0_updater_desc: Decoupled web bundle and native shell updates with multi-tier proxy fallback directly connecting to GitHub Releases.
items.v0_2_0_perf_title: Virtual Message List & Local SQLite Optimizations
items.v0_2_0_perf_desc: Sub-millisecond loading of massive chat message histories and full-text search with significantly reduced RAM and CPU usage.
items.v0_2_0_fix_audio_title: Audio Device Switching & Channel Reset Fixes
items.v0_2_0_fix_audio_desc: Improved device plug-and-play handling across multi-soundcard setups, eliminating audio mixing anomalies and resource leaks.
items.v0_3_0_media_desc: Preview inline image links, open the lightbox, and renew access after permission checks. Channels and controls gain interaction animations.
items.v0_3_0_desktop_desc: Configure server addresses at build time, fix local resource loading in installations and incremental updates, and improve four-track denoising comparisons.
items.v0_3_0_security_desc: Upgrade to Electron 41.10.6 to fix known issues with context isolation, protocol access, and sandboxing, and update build dependencies.
